name: Multi-resolution Convex Contouring
aliases: Multi-resolution Convex Contouring with Decision Trees
definition: A view-dependent approach where the grid is contoured at different resolutions depending on the distance from the viewer, using nested bounding boxes with resolution decreasing by a factor of 2.
summary: Multi-resolution Convex Contouring accelerates volume rendering by extracting surfaces at varying grid resolutions based on viewer distance, using transition cells to maintain topological consistency and reduce triangle counts.
